description: ask the thinking plugin to create a joseki-scoped Work Breakdown Structure fragment for a specific work item within a phase, guided by a named joseki card.
embedding_description: Create joseki-scoped work breakdown structure fragment. Initialize a work-item-scoped execution document following a specific joseki card sequence. The fragment covers one work item, not a full phase. Includes joseki_key and work_item_id metadata for provenance.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: The full created joseki-scoped WBS fragment document
result_processor_customizations.output_action_guidance: The joseki-scoped Work Breakdown Structure fragment has been created and is now available as working context. Continue executing the current step as shown in the updated ACTIVE_PLAN.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Creating a joseki-scoped Work Breakdown Structure fragment. create_joseki_work_breakdown_structure accepts {wbs_id, manifest_id, phase_number, phase_name, joseki_key, work_item_id, directive, support_articles}. The thinking model generates the WBS fragment following the named joseki card.
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: ValidationError: arguments do not conform to the schema. StorageError: knowledge base write failed. FileExistsError: a WBS with this ID already exists.
